hook.name: PRNTRHook
hook.description: Charges configurable fees on WETH-paired pool swaps, overriding LP fees to zero and taking WETH directly via swap deltas. Applies an elevated 85% sniper fee during the first 30 seconds after pool launch, then reverts to a registered per-pool fee tier. Factory-initiated swaps are fee-exempt; accumulated WETH fees are claimable by the factory.
